heading: How it works
lead: Bulk-edit your YouTube videos safely: preview, review, back up, and undo. Screenshots use sample videos.

steps.alt: The Connect your YouTube channel card with a Sign in with Google button
steps.caption: Sign in with the Google account that owns your channel.

steps.alt: The Videos list on a phone, with three videos ticked
steps.caption: Sync your public videos and tick the ones to change.

steps.alt: The Edit screen with Append to Description chosen and the text to add filled in
steps.caption: Choose an edit and type the text to add.

steps.alt: The Review screen showing a before-and-after diff for each video
steps.caption: Review every change. Nothing is written yet.

steps.alt: A finished run: each video backed up, then updated
steps.caption: Apply: each video is backed up, then updated.

steps.alt: The Restore dialog, offering to put back the descriptions a run replaced
steps.caption: Changed your mind? Restore a whole run, or one video.
